sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Xie'Jing is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. She is the Witch of the Abyss who is known as the harbinger of plague and pestilence, who bears hatred toward humans.

sections.title: Personality
sections.content:
Xie'Jing is known by her art of seducing handsome young men and will be able to manipulate them in her own accord, and later will drain their life force to maintain her youth and beauty. She also expresses hate towards humans.

Xie'Jing also expressed hatred towards her son Long by "making his life as miserable as possible" and abandoning him.

sections.title: History
sections.content:
In Witch of the Abyss, Xie'Jing abducts and brainwashes Fei, forcing him to be in love and to work only for Xie'Jing. Fang, Fei's lover, asks the Summoner for guidance to help rescue Fei. Eventually, Xie'Jing crumbles into defeat and is slain by Fang, losing control over Fei.

Upon defeat, Noel decides to analyze the data gathered from the Vortex and creates a Mock Unit of Xie'Jing. He also rewards the Summoner the Mock Unit should he/she defeat her in a trial.

In Forgotten Shadows, which takes place decades after Xie'Jing's initial defeat, Xie'Jing resurrects. Feng, Fei and Fang's daughter, meets Xie'Jing, who manages to take control over Fei and Fang. Xie'Jing, once again, is slain by Feng, who was also aided by Long.

Xie'Jing's Mock Unit appears once again in her upgraded Omni form in the Strategy Zone.

sections.title: Abilities
sections.content: See Temptress Xie'Jing and Demonic Witch Xie'Jing

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- Xie'Jing (邪径) means "depraved life", "evil ways", and "fornication".
- Xie'Jing holds the honor of being the first Global Exclusive unit obtained from Trial as well as the first Global Exclusive unit obtained at Omni Level from Strategy Zone.
